title: Tim Dooley — Life, Persona and Myth Timeline
purpose: A source-aware timeline separating the public digital record, uncertain biographical reconstruction and the internal Potatoverse mythic chronology. It is designed to discover structure without inventing a birth date or treating mythology as biography.

identity_resolution.important_warning: The name Tim Dooley and the name Thomas Dall have many unrelated web matches. A search result is not sufficient to identify the Potatoverse subject. The timeline therefore records source status and confidence for every biographical claim.
identity_resolution.repository_rule: Do not silently merge unrelated people, especially the astronomer Thomas Dall, other Tim Dooleys, or unrelated Thomas Dall business/person records.

timeline_axes.human_public_axis: Events that may describe the contemporary person or public persona, sourced from public profiles, self-authored statements or secondary archives.
timeline_axes.mythic_axis: Events inside the Potatoverse story: Source → Father → Son → Death → Potato → Tim, etc. These are project mythology rather than verified biography.
timeline_axes.research_axis: Questions whose dates or causal relationships remain unresolved and should be investigated before being promoted into canon.

events.title: Birth of the human person
events.description: No reliable source located in this research pass establishes the exact birth date of the contemporary Tim Dooley / Potato of Life subject.
events.research_question: Can a Danish civil, court, parliamentary, electoral, archival or self-authored source establish the date and place of birth without confusing this person with another Tim Dooley or Thomas Dall?

events.title: Childhood and family formation
events.description: The available web search produced conflicting or hostile secondary accounts but no sufficiently reliable primary biography for childhood, parents, siblings or birthplace.
events.research_question: Locate primary or independently verifiable biographical material before writing family history into the repository.

events.title: Beginning of the claimed twelve-year spiritual war
events.description: On September 7, 2026, the public @Rational_Potato profile states that being God is the culmination of '12 years of spiritual war'. If the phrase is intended literally as a twelve-year duration ending in 2026, it points approximately to 2014. The starting year is therefore an inference, not a verified event date.
events.research_question: Find the earliest surviving self-authored material that explains what the claimed spiritual war began with and whether 12 years refers to a continuous period, a symbolic number, or an approximate duration.

events.title: A documented Danish public/legal episode under the Thomas Dall name
events.confidence: low-to-medium for identity until primary-source verification
events.description: Web searches locate reporting and secondary archival claims about a Danish person named Thomas Dall and a 2016 political-threat case. These sources may be relevant to the contemporary subject, but the repository should not treat the identity link as established solely from hostile archives.
events.research_question: Retrieve the original Danish court/news records and verify whether they refer to the same person now using Tim Dooley / The Potato of Life.
sources: secondary public archive; Copenhagen Post lead cited by that archive

events.title: Kittystyle / early streaming period
events.description: Public archive material describes a Kittystyle-era streaming identity and a 2019 transition/disclosure period. Because the archive is adversarial, these claims are retained as leads rather than canonical biography.
events.research_question: Build a neutral platform chronology from surviving primary uploads, account metadata and platform records.
sources: public adversarial archive; primary material should be located

events.title: Identity rupture / end of the older persona
events.description: Secondary archives describe a major 2019 rupture in the Kittystyle/Thomas Dall public identity. The Potatoverse later gives this general pattern a mythic form: the former Son dies and another identity emerges.
events.research_question: Separate the actual 2019 digital-persona change from the later mythic reinterpretation of that change.
sources: public adversarial archive; primary uploads needed

events.title: Public @Rational_Potato account begins
events.description: A public profile mirror currently lists the @Rational_Potato account as having joined in March 2023. This is the earliest concrete date located in this search that anchors the current Potato of Life digital persona.
events.research_question: Find the first surviving post, first video, first use of 'Tim Dooley', and first use of 'Potato of Life' around March 2023.

events.title: Potato of Life becomes the active public persona
events.description: The current public profile describes itself with the Potato of Life, Father of Jesus, World Tree, Spudlight, Mythical Heavenly Gardener, King of Kings, Throne of North, Potatoism and 100k-hour streamer vocabulary. These are self-description elements, not independent evidence of supernatural claims.

events.title: Publicly archived Potatoverse transmission marker
events.description: A September 2026 public archive indexes an August 11 2026 Potatoverse-related transmission marker. It should be treated as an archival timestamp, not automatically as the origin of the mythology.

events.title: Public transcript exposes the developed Potatoverse architecture
events.description: A September 2 2026 transcript records the developed architecture: Tim as Father principle, Potato of Love, North of North, Axis above Axis; the Potato as relational totality; an 11-dimensional Calabi–Yau potato metaphor; Tim as still point; and the world as the field in which repair, building and responsibility occur.
events.source: Timbo’s AI Says His Potatoverse is Fiction, September 2 2026

events.title: The '12 years' statement becomes a chronological clue
events.description: The @Rational_Potato profile states that 'Me being God is the culmination of 12 years of spiritual war'. This is useful because it gives a duration claim that can be tested against older public material. It does not establish a supernatural fact.

events.title: The Son dies
events.description: The Potatoverse places the Son's death/crucifixion at the centre of the transformation that makes the Door, Ladder and later Tim/Potato identity possible. The exact calendar date has not been established in the repository.
events.research_question: Determine whether the project has a specific date encoded in older notes, streams, songs, Christmas/North Pole material or archived conversations.

events.title: Tim emerges from the Potato after the Son's death
events.confidence: high as project premise; no historical date
events.description: Within the project story, the Tim figure emerges after the Son's death through the Potato of Life. The Potato is therefore not merely Tim's emblem; it is the medium of transformation from Son/death into Father/Tim/life.
events.research_question: Search the earliest Potatoverse material for the first explicit formulation of 'Tim came from the Potato' and the exact sequence between Son death, Potato, rebirth and Tim.
events.source: Potatoverse canon and current project chronology

events.title: Potato transformation sequence
events.description: The current mythic ontology gives the sequence Tim Dooley → spiritual domain → Source → Father → Father's House → Heaven → Throne of North; then Throne → Axis → Ladder → Door → Son/Vessel → Plane → World; and Son → Death → Crucifixion → Transformation → Door/Ladder → Return.

events.title: Tree cycle becomes the long-term form of Tim's world
events.description: After transformation, the architecture becomes Tree of Life: Roots → Trunk → Branches → Leaves → Fruit → Seed, with Tree of Strife as the failure pattern and Return as repair.

derived_windows.name: Possible beginning of twelve-year period
derived_windows.meaning: A candidate research window, not a birth date or proven event.

derived_windows.name: Current Potato persona minimum age
derived_windows.meaning: The current digital persona demonstrably existed by March 2023, but the mythology may predate the account.

derived_windows.name: Mythic birth date
derived_windows.meaning: The Son's death and Tim's emergence are presently relative mythic events rather than dated historical events.

research_priorities: Find the first surviving use of the exact name Tim Dooley in connection with the Potato of Life.
Find the first surviving use of Potato of Life / Potatoism / Spudlight / Throne of North.
Search 2013–2015 public material specifically for the claimed beginning of the 12-year spiritual war.
Search 2019–2023 material for the transition from Thomas/Kittystyle to the Tim/Potato persona.
Locate the first explicit statement that the Son is dead and Tim emerges from the Potato.
Determine whether Christmas, December 25, the North Pole or another date is used as the mythic transformation date.
Build a source-separated childhood/family/birth record only from primary or independently verifiable material.
Search older videos, songs, stream titles, X posts and archived pages rather than relying on hostile retrospective summaries.
Create a date-confidence model so exact dates, approximate dates, relative mythic dates and unknown dates cannot be confused.
